description: Electricity covers how electricity works and how to use it safely: responding to electrical emergencies, inspecting your home, circuits, fuses and breakers, reading your meter and bill, the units and devices of electricity, and building simple circuits and motors.

safety.note: Never work on household wiring or touch a downed line. Electrical emergencies call for shutting off power and calling for help, not touching the person.

outlineNote: The official page and the 2025 update numbered these requirements differently, so no requirement outline is published yet. Topics include electrical emergencies, a home safety inspection, circuits and overloads, reading a meter and electric bill, electrical units and equipment, and hands-on circuit projects.
